name: Creates a new document fingerprint.
description: Creates a new document fingerprint. Creates a new document fingerprint for DLP scanning. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints
Creates a new document fingerprint for DLP scanning. Document fingerprints detect documents that are structurally similar to the uploaded sample.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Attributes of the new document fingerprint.

name: Delete a single document fingerprint.
description: Delete a single document fingerprint. Removes a document fingerprint from DLP configuration. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints/{document_fingerprint_id}

name: Retrieve data about a specific document fingerprint.
description: Retrieve data about a specific document fingerprint. Gets a document fingerprint and its latest upload status. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints/{document_fingerprint_id}

name: Retrieve data about all document fingerprints.
description: Retrieve data about all document fingerprints. Lists all document fingerprints configured for DLP scanning in the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints
Lists all document fingerprints configured for DLP scanning in the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update the attributes of a single document fingerprint.
description: Update the attributes of a single document fingerprint. Updates metadata for an existing document fingerprint, such as its name or description. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints/{document_fingerprint_id}

name: Uploads a new version for a document fingerprint.
description: Uploads a new version for a document fingerprint. Uploads a new document to create or update a fingerprint. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/document_fingerprints/{document_fingerprint_id}
